 O R D E R

Apprehending arrest in Crime No.1393/2021 of Central Police Station, Ernakulam, registered for offences punishable under Sections 468, 471, 420 and Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code, the 1st accused has filed this application under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure seeking pre- arrest bail.

2. The prosecution case is that the petitioner along with accused No.2 had approached the Branch Manager, Indian Overseas Bank, M.G. Road Branch requesting for a loan to finance the purchase of a second-hand Mercedes Benz car having registration number KL-62C-606.

It is further alleged that for the purpose of availing loan both the accused submitted a fabricated agreement dated 12-01-2019 executed between accused No.2 and one Mr.Santhosh Kumar who is the owner of the car.

It is further alleged that on the basis of agreement dated 12-01-2019 executed between the accused No.2 and one Mr.Santhosh Kumar and agreement dated 02-03-2019 executed BAIL APPL.NO.503 OF 2022 between accused No.1 and 2 bank sanctioned a loan of Rs.14 Lakhs and the amount was credited in the account of accused No.2.

It is also alleged that the petitioner defaulted in the payment of instalments and when the bank enquired about the matter it is understood that vehicle was under the ownership of one Mr. Mohammed Latheef and not that of the petitioner.
Thus, the accused have committed the alleged offences mentioned above.
3. The learned counsel for the petitioner contended that the prosecution allegations are false and the offences against the petitioner will not lie.
4. I have considered the rival contentions.

5. It is seen that this Court had granted an interim order, on 23.08.2023 directing the petitioner to surrender before the investigating officer within a period of three weeks for subjecting himself to interrogation.

It was also directed that, on such surrender, the petitioner shall be released on bail on executing a bond for Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) with two solvent sureties each for the like sum to the BAIL APPL.NO.503 OF 2022 satisfaction of the Investigating Officer.
6. The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that pursuant to the above order, the petitioner had appeared before the Investigating Officer as directed and has been released on bail.

7. In such circumstances, I am inclined to pass an order making the earlier interim order absolute,
subject to the following conditions:
1.The petitioner shall co-operate with the Investigating Officer and shall appear as and when directed by the Investigating Officer.

2.The petitioner shall not intimidate or attempt to influence the witnesses, tamper with any evidence, or get involved in similar offences while on bail.
